description: pkix-revocation/tests/crl_checker_tests.rs — The dedicated CRL checker unit tests (crl_checker_tests.rs) contain no tests for delta CRL behavior, including the RemoveFromCRL path and the CrlChecker::with_delta constructor. This functionality is only exercised by the PKITS corpus (pkits_crl.rs). If pkits_crl.rs fixtures are unavailable or skipped, the delta CRL merge logic has no unit test coverage. Fix: add focused unit tests in crl_checker_tests.rs for: (1) with_delta construction validation, (2) delta entry overrides base entry, (3) RemoveFromCRL in delta removes cert from base, (4) cert in delta only with RemoveFromCRL is not revoked.
title: No integration tests for delta CRL RemoveFromCRL in crl_checker_tests.rs
